## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bediene die Spezialmaschinen für die Fahrleitungs- und Kabelverlegung, übernehme Sicherheitsaufgaben und unterstütze die Fahrleitungsteams bei den Bauausführungen. Freue dich auf spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten als Handwerker:in und Lokführer:in und werde Teil eines familiären Teams. In dieser Tätigkeit kombinierst du handwerkliches Geschick mit Sicherheitsbewusstsein und organisatorischem Talent. Bist du ambitioniert? Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und neue Fähigkeiten zu erwerben.
Unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten sowie Schichtarbeit siehst du für dich als Vorteil für deine flexible Freizeitgestaltung. Geleistete Nacht- und Wochenendarbeit werden bei uns zusätzlich honoriert. Zudem erhältst du grosszügige Zeitzuschläge.
Auf unserer Webseite findest du weitere Informationen zu unseren Benefits .
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Monteur:in führst du zusammen mit deinem Team alle vorkommenden Unterhalts- und Erneuerungsarbeiten mit dem Hauptbereich Kettenwerk an Fahrleitungsanlagen aus.
- Bedienung der Fahrleitungszugmaschine erfordert selbstständiges Arbeiten, erfolgt jedoch immer im Zweierteam – Teamfähigkeit und klare Absprachen sind daher essenziell.
- Du bist bereit, die entsprechende Ausbildung zum/zur Triebfahrzeugführer:in (Lokführer:in) zu absolvieren.
- Mit deinem Know-how und handwerklichem Geschick, kannst du mit verschiedenen Arbeitsgeräten umgehen. Wobei die Sicherheit für dich an oberster Stelle steht.
- Es macht dir nichts aus, zu unregelmässigen Zeiten, insbesondere in der Nacht und am Wochenende, zu arbeiten.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in mit ausgeprägtem Sicherheitsbewusstsein und hast Freude daran, dich fachlich und personell stets weiterzuentwickeln.
- Du arbeitest gerne körperlich aktiv im Freien.
- Die Motivation, dich zum:r Triebfahrzeugführer:in Kategorie B100 oder A ausbilden zu lassen, bringst du hierfür mit. Während der Vollzeitausbildung (4-9 Monate) wirst du zu 100% entlohnt.
- Für diese Stelle benötigst du eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche Berufslehre EFZ. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen Führerausweis Kat. B.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 0. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

Montatore: in catenaria trattore / macchinista di locomotiva: a Duliken, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Aziona le macchine speciali per la posa di linee di contatto e cavi, assumi compiti di sicurezza e supporta le squadre delle linee di contatto nei lavori di costruzione. Attendi con ansia lavori entusiasmanti e vari come artigiano e macchinista ed entra a far parte di un team di famiglia. In questo lavoro combini competenze tecniche con consapevolezza della sicurezza e talento organizzativo. Sei ambizioso? Con noi hai l'opportunità di svilupparti continuamente e acquisire nuove competenze. Consideri gli orari di lavoro irregolari e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per le tue attività flessibili nel tempo libero. Paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana. Riceverai anche generose indennità di tempo. Puoi trovare maggiori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi sul nostro sito web. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di installatore, tu e il tuo team eseguite tutti i lavori di manutenzione e rinnovamento con l'area principale del lavoro a catena sui sistemi di linee di contatto. - Il funzionamento del trattore a catenaria richiede un lavoro indipendente, ma viene sempre svolto in una squadra di due persone: sono quindi essenziali il lavoro di squadra e accordi chiari. - Possiedi la formazione adeguata come macchinista (macchinista) o la volontà di ottenerla. - Con le tue conoscenze e abilità manuali, puoi maneggiare diversi strumenti. La sicurezza è la tua massima priorità. - Non ti dispiace lavorare ad orari irregolari, soprattutto di notte e nei fine settimana. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei un giocatore di squadra con un forte senso di sicurezza e ti piace svilupparti continuamente a livello professionale e personale. - Hai la motivazione per seguire una formazione come macchinista nella categoria B100 o A. Durante la formazione a tempo pieno (4-9 mesi) sarai pagato al 100%. - Per questa posizione è necessario aver completato un apprendistato artigianale (EFZ). Possiedi anche una patente di guida di categoria B. - Ti piace lavorare fisicamente attivamente all'aria aperta. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 0. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione finale Domanda Decisione finale Domande? Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Fitter: in catenary tractor / locomotive driver: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Fitter: in catenary tractor / locomotive driver: in Dulliken, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Operate the special machines for laying contact lines and cables, take on safety tasks and support the contact line teams in the construction work. Look forward to exciting and varied jobs as a craftsman and train driver and become part of a family team. In this job, you combine technical skills with security awareness and organizational talent. Are you ambitious? With us you have the opportunity to continuously develop and acquire new skills. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage for your flexible leisure activities. We pay additional compensation for night and weekend work. You also receive generous time allowances. You can find more information about our benefits on our website. You can move that. - As a fitter, you and your team carry out all maintenance and renewal work with the main area of ​​chain work on contact line systems. - Operating the catenary tractor requires independent work, but is always carried out in a team of two - teamwork and clear agreements are therefore essential. - You have the appropriate training as a train driver (locomotive driver) or the willingness to obtain it. - With your know-how and manual skills, you can handle various tools. Safety is your top priority. - You don't mind working at irregular hours, especially at night and on weekends. This is what you bring with you. - You are a team player with a strong sense of security and enjoy continually developing yourself professionally and personally. - You have the motivation to be trained as a train driver in category B100 or A. During full-time training (4-9 months) you will be paid 100%. - For this position you need to have completed a craft apprenticeship (EFZ). You also have a driving license Category B. - You enjoy working physically actively outdoors. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. This is what you bring with you. - Reliability is what sets you apart and is reflected in punctuality, quality and safety awareness. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training with EFZ, ideally in the area of ​​traffic logistics or have already gained experience as a shunter or train driver in the past. - You have a valid BAV ID card for train drivers in category A40 according to VTE or are willing to obtain one. - Good knowledge of German (at least level B2) both spoken and written rounds off your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Sicherheitswärter:in sorgst du dafür, dass Arbeiten im Gleisbereich mit Einhaltung der Sicherheitsmassnahmen sicher durchgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsalltag ist genauso abwechslungsreich wie deine Arbeitszeiten und die unterschiedlichen Einsatzorte, die du entlang der schönsten Bahnstrecken der Schweiz führst.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- In deiner Zuständigkeit fällt der Schutz des Personals sowie des Materials und der Geräte vor den Gefahren des Bahnbetriebes und der Bahnstromanlagen.
- Als Sicherheitswärter:in warnst du Kolleginnen und Kollegen auf der Bahnbaustelle vor herannahenden Zügen.
- Du bist verantwortlich für das Aufziehen sowie Durchführen eines Sicherheitsdispositivs und die direkte Kommunikation per Telefon oder Funk mit den zuständigen Stellen.
- Du informierst die Baustellenverantwortlichen über festgestellte aussergewöhnliche Vorkommnisse in deren Tätigkeitsbereich.
- Du bist viel unterwegs und übest diese Tätigkeit an verschiedenen Standorten deiner Region aus.
Hier mehr zum Berufsbild.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit bist du bereit selbständig, zuverlässig, teamfähig und offen, im Schichtbetrieb (Früh-, Tag-, Nacht und Wochenendeinsätze) zu arbeiten.
- Du bist körperlich und psychisch belastbar und zeichnest dich durch ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein aus.
- Idealerweise hast du eine Grundausbildung (EBA / EFZ) abgeschlossen oder bringst bereits Berufserfahrung im handwerklichen, logistischen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit. Dazu hast du die Ausbildung als Sicherheitswärter:in oder Sicherheitschef:in abgeschlossen oder bist bereit diese zu absolvieren.
- Im Umgang mit verschiedenen digitalen Arbeitsmitteln (iPad und iPhone) und Anwendungen bist du geschickt und bereit, dich stets weiterzubilden und dazuzulernen.
- Deine fliessenden Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache sind wünschenswert.
- Einen gültigen Fahrausweis der Kategorie B (Personenwagen mit manueller Handschaltung) und ein gutes Seh- und Hörvermögen runden dein Profil ab.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Guardiano di sicurezza con ingresso laterale / capo della sicurezza Winterthur, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, ti assicuri che i lavori nell'area della pista siano svolti in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle misure di sicurezza. La vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è tanto varia quanto i vostri orari di lavoro e i diversi luoghi in cui viaggiate lungo le più belle tratte ferroviarie della Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - Sei responsabile della protezione del personale, dei materiali e delle attrezzature dai pericoli delle operazioni ferroviarie e dei sistemi di trazione. - In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, avverti i colleghi del cantiere ferroviario dell'avvicinarsi dei treni. - Sei responsabile della creazione e dell'implementazione di un sistema di sicurezza e della comunicazione diretta via telefono o radio con le autorità competenti. - Informare i responsabili del cantiere di eventuali incidenti insoliti rilevati nella loro area di attività. - Viaggi molto e svolgi questa attività in diverse località della tua regione. Maggiori informazioni sulla descrizione del lavoro qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei pronto a lavorare in modo indipendente, affidabile, come giocatore di squadra e apertamente, a turni (turni mattutini, diurni, notturni e nei fine settimana). - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e hai un forte senso di sicurezza. - Idealmente, hai completato la formazione di base (EBA / EFZ) o hai già esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in un settore comparabile. Hai completato la tua formazione come guardia di sicurezza o capo della sicurezza o sei pronto a completarla. - Sei abile nell'uso di vari strumenti di lavoro digitale (iPad e iPhone) e applicazioni e sei disposto a istruirti e apprendere continuamente. - Le tue competenze in tedesco fluente completano il tuo profilo. E' auspicabile la conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale. - Una patente di guida di categoria B valida (autovettura con cambio manuale) e una buona vista e udito completano il tuo profilo. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Lateral entry security guard / head of security Winterthur, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a safety guard, you ensure that work in the track area is carried out safely and in compliance with safety measures. Your everyday working life is just as varied as your working hours and the different locations you travel along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You are responsible for protecting staff, materials and equipment from the dangers of railway operations and traction power systems. - As a security guard, you warn colleagues at the railway construction site about approaching trains. - You are responsible for setting up and implementing a security system and communicating directly by telephone or radio with the responsible authorities. - You inform those responsible for the construction site about any unusual incidents that have been identified in their area of ​​activity. - You travel a lot and carry out this activity at different locations in your region. More about the job description here. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are prepared to work independently, reliably, as a team player and openly, in shifts (early morning, day, night and weekend shifts). - You are physically and mentally resilient and have a strong sense of security. - Ideally, you have completed basic training (EBA / EFZ) or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. You have completed your training as a security guard or head of security or are ready to complete it. - You are skilled at using various digital work tools (iPad and iPhone) and applications and are willing to continually educate yourself and learn. - Your fluent German skills round off your profile. Knowledge of a second national language is desirable. - A valid category B driving license (passenger car with manual transmission) and good eyesight and hearing complete your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102856 Andreas Müller, team leader Telephone +41 79 894 01 98 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. This ensures that our customers can travel with the highest possible comfort. You also make your contribution to a good climate, especially on the train. - You independently operate the air conditioning test devices to carry out input and output tests as well as diagnoses on the air conditioning devices. - You are responsible for the refrigeration interventions of the air conditioning units and carry them out with high efficiency and quality. - With your extensive know-how, you enjoy supporting the team. This is what you bring with you. - In our industry, teamwork is the key to success. You are an absolute team player with the ability to work in an interdisciplinary manner. - You act proactively and enjoy working independently. You systematically plan your next work steps in advance. Your solution-oriented way of thinking and acting makes your work easier in our dynamic and challenging environment. - Very good technical understanding and experience in remanufacturing in an industrial production company are an advantage. - You have basic training in the mechanical or electromechanical field with an EFZ qualification. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Auf dich wartet eine abwechslungsreiche, bezahlte 9-monatige Vollzeitausbildung. Die theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du in Olten oder in Zürich und deine ersten Praxiserfahrungen sammelst du in einem regional zugeteilten Rangierbahnhof.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. - Du leistest und führst verschiedene und komplexe Rangierbewegungen von Zügen bis zu maximal 100 km/h selbstständig, formierst und zerlegst diese und bereitest sie für die Fahrt vor.
- Um die regionale Logistik sicherzustellen, entwirfst, beantragst und bestellst du Fahrordnungen termingerecht und verantwortest die Versorgung von Baustellen mit den erforderlichen Materialien.
- Du hast eine hohe Verantwortung in der Betriebssicherheit der Bauzüge. Das Prüfen der Arbeitsstellensicherheit sowie Erstellen von Rapporten runden die Tätigkeiten ab.
- Zusätzlich wirst du als Lokführerinnen und Lokführer Bauzüge auf der Baustelle eingesetzt und dein handwerkliches Geschick wird gefordert.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit bist du gewissenhaft, zuverlässig, teamfähig und bereit im 24 Stunden Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du bist körperlich und psychisch belastbar und kannst mit deiner eigenverantwortlichen Arbeitsweise bewusst und richtig agieren.
- Du hast eine mindestens zweijährige anerkannte Berufslehre inkl. Fähigkeitsausweis, idealerweise in der Baubranche und mit Erfahrungen im Gleisbau oder abgeschlossene Matura.
- Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C1) in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung.
- Du besitzt den Führerausweis Kategorie B.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot-Grün-Schwäche) und weist keine Einträge im Straf- und Betreibungsregister auf.

Ti aspetta un programma di formazione a tempo pieno di 9 mesi vario e retribuito. Completate la vostra formazione teorica a Olten o Zurigo e fate la vostra prima esperienza pratica in uno scalo di smistamento assegnato a livello regionale. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Olten, May 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Wir bilden dich zur Spezialistin/zum Spezialisten für komplexe Elektro-Stellwerk-Anlagen aus. So kannst du einen massgeblichen Beitrag dazu leisten, dass unseren Kundinnen und Kunden jederzeit hochverfügbare und sichere Signal- und Automationsanlagen zur Verfügung stehen. In internen Ausbildungskursen wirst du intensiv und professionell auf deine zukünftige Aufgabe vorbereitet. Zudem besteht die Möglichkeit, dich stetig weiterzuentwickeln und Aufgaben mit mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Ein ambitioniertes und motiviertes Team freut sich auf ein neues Teammitglied. Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, unsere Benefits wie Kinderzulagen, kostenloses 2. Klasse GA und vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie – findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits .
Das kannst du bewegen.
- In deiner Funktion führst du selbständig Bau- und Unterhaltstätigkeiten an den bahntechnischen Elektro-Anlagen primär im Innenbereich aus.
- Dabei wirkst du aktiv mit, die Zuverlässigkeit, die Verfügbarkeit und die Sicherheit der Bahninfrastrukturanlagen wirtschaftlich zu gewährleisten.
- Du leistest Pikettdienst, um Störungen an den komplexen Anlagen zu beheben und deren Verfügbarkeit sicherzustellen.
- Abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekt arbeitest du sporadisch in der Nacht wie auch an Wochenenden. Selbstverständlich werden diese geleisteten Arbeitsstunden zusätzlich entsprechend honoriert.
- Damit du erfolgreich diese wichtige Funktion ausführen kannst, durchläufst du eine zweijährige berufsbegleitende interne Weiterbildung. Wir bilden dich aus, damit du selbständig Störungen an den Innenanlagen lokalisieren und beheben lernen kannst.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist eine technisch affine Persönlichkeit, selbständig sowie eigeninitiativ und bist für die anfallenden Tätigkeiten jederzeit flexibel in deiner Arbeitsweise.
- Für diese Position benötigst du eine abgeschlossene 4-jährige elektrotechnische Grundausbildung EFZ (Automatiker:in, Elektrotechniker:in, Elektroinstallateur:in oder artverwandte Berufe).
- Voraussetzung für den Stellenantritt ist ein gutes Hör- und Sehvermögen, damit du bei Einsätzen im Gleisbereich wichtige akustische und visuelle Signale erkennen kannst.
- Für diese Position benötigst du einen Führerausweis Kategorie B. Idealerweise wohnst du in der Region Brugg, um während des Pikettdienstes innerhalb von ca. 30 Minuten am Einsatzort zu sein.
- Wir erwarten sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse (B2-C2).

Ingegnere dell'automazione, elettrotecnico o installatore elettrico nel campo della tecnologia degli apparecchi di segnalazione Brugg AG, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Automation engineer, electrical engineer or electrical installer in the field of signal box technology Brugg AG, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We will train you to become a specialist for complex electrical interlocking systems. In this way, you can make a significant contribution to ensuring that our customers have highly available and secure signaling and automation systems at all times. In internal training courses you will be intensively and professionally prepared for your future role. There is also the opportunity to continually develop yourself and take on tasks with more responsibility. An ambitious and motivated team is looking forward to a new team member. You can move that. - In your role, you independently carry out construction and maintenance activities on the railway electrical systems, primarily indoors. - You will be actively involved in economically ensuring the reliability, availability and safety of the railway infrastructure systems. - You provide on-call duty to resolve faults in the complex systems and ensure their availability. - Depending on the respective project, you will work sporadically at night and on weekends. Of course, these hours worked will also be rewarded accordingly. - So that you can successfully carry out this important function, you will undergo two years of part-time internal training. descriptionByLocale.fr: Ingénieur en automatisation, ingénieur électricien ou installateur électrique dans le domaine de la technologie de verrouillage 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Ingénieur en automatisation, ingénieur électricien ou installateur électricien dans le domaine de la technologie des boîtes de signalisation Brugg AG, dès maintenant ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en attendre avec impatience. Nous vous formerons pour devenir un spécialiste des systèmes de verrouillage électriques complexes. De cette manière, vous pouvez contribuer de manière significative à garantir à nos clients des systèmes de signalisation et d’automatisation hautement disponibles et sécurisés à tout moment. Lors des formations internes, vous serez préparé de manière intensive et professionnelle à votre futur rôle. Il y a aussi la possibilité de se développer continuellement et d'assumer des tâches avec plus de responsabilités. Une équipe ambitieuse et motivée attend avec impatience un nouveau membre. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous. Vous trouverez nos avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Dans votre rôle, vous réalisez en toute autonomie des activités de construction et de maintenance sur les systèmes électriques ferroviaires, principalement en intérieur. - Vous participerez activement à assurer économiquement la fiabilité, la disponibilité et la sécurité des systèmes d'infrastructure ferroviaire. - Vous effectuez des astreintes pour résoudre les pannes des systèmes complexes et assurer leur disponibilité. - En fonction du projet concerné, vous travaillerez sporadiquement la nuit et le week-end. Bien entendu, ces heures travaillées seront également récompensées en conséquence. - Afin que vous puissiez exercer avec succès cette fonction importante, vous suivrez deux années de formation interne à temps partiel. Nous vous formons afin que vous puissiez localiser et résoudre de manière indépendante les défauts des systèmes intérieurs. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes une personnalité techniquement compétente, indépendante et proactive et êtes toujours flexible dans votre façon de travailler pour les tâches impliquées. - Pour ce poste, vous avez besoin d'une formation de base en électrotechnique de 4 ans complétée EFZ (ingénieur automatique, ingénieur électricien, électricien ou professions connexes). - La condition préalable pour prendre ce poste est une bonne audition et une bonne vision afin que vous puissiez reconnaître les signaux acoustiques et visuels importants lorsque vous travaillez dans la zone des voies. - Pour ce poste, vous avez besoin d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B. Idéalement, vous habitez dans la région de Brugg afin de pouvoir être sur place en 30 minutes environ en cas de garde. - Nous attendons de très bonnes compétences en allemand oral et écrit (B2-C2). ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. ## Das kannst du bewegen:
- Als Netzelektriker:in führst du zusammen mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen alle vorkommenden Unterhalts-, Erneuerungsarbeiten und Störungsbehebungen an Fahrleitungsanlagen aus.
- Im Laufe der Ausbildung lernst du die Hubarbeitsbühne zu bedienen.
- Unter Aufsicht einer sachverständigen Person führst du Schalthandlungen im Fahrleitungsnetz durch. Nach der Lehre bist du schaltberechtigt auf dem Netz der SBB Infrastruktur.
- Du bist bereit, zu unregelmässigen Zeiten zu arbeiten, insbesondere nachts und teilweise am Wochenende. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet. Zudem profitierst du von Zeitzuschlägen. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

## Das bringst du mit:
- Du bist mindestens 25 Jahre alt und hast Lust, einen neuen Beruf zu erlernen.
- Du bist handwerklich geschickt und verfügst idealerweise über praktische Erfahrungen im Fahrleitungs-, Freileitungs- oder Metallbau.
- Du bist gerne bei Wind und Wetter draussen.
- Netzelektriker:innen können sich aufeinander verlassen, denn Teamgeist ist genauso wichtig wie Sicherheitsvorschriften.
- Du hast ein gutes Seh- und Hörvermögen und keine Farbsinneinschränkung

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen:
Als Netzelektriker:in sorgst du täglich dafür, dass der Strom fliesst, damit unsere Kunden und Kundinnen pünktlich und sicher an ihr Ziel kommen. Du arbeitest mit deiner eigenen Körperkraft oder lässt modernste Maschinen diese Arbeit für Dich erledigen.
Deine Berufserfahrung ist und etwas wert. Je mehr relevante Berufserfahrung du mitbringst, desto höher wird dein Gehalt während und nach der Lehre sein: Im ersten Lehrjahr beträgt dein Gehalt 80%, im zweiten Lehrjahr bereits 90% und im dritten Lehrjahr 95% deines errechneten Lohns nach Abschluss der Lehre. Gerne machen wir dir im Rahmen des Erstgesprächs einen provisorischen Lohnvorschlag.
Deine dreijährige Ausbildung absolvierst du in einem Fahrleitungsteam der SBB Infrastruktur, angestellt bist du bei login, unserer Partnerin für Berufsbildung. Dabei wirst du von einem:r qualifizierten Berufsbildner:in begleitet. Parallel dazu besuchst du die Berufsschule.
Interessiert? Bei Fragen zur Ausbildung kannst du dich direkt an Rolf Bähni (+41 79 621 26 04) wenden. Du erreichst uns während unserer Bürozeiten von 08:00 bis 17:00 Uhr.
Der Bewerbungsprozess wird durch unsere Ausbildungspartnerin login Berufsbildung AG durchgeführt. Für Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess steht dir das Bewerbungszentrum von login gerne zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it: Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come elettricista di rete: in EFZ | login Formazione professionale - - - - - - - - La vostra posizione nel mondo della mobilità In qualità di partner educativo delle FFS, della BLS, della RhB, dell'Associazione dei trasporti pubblici (VöV) e di oltre 80 altre aziende legate alla mobilità e alla mobilità, login Berufsbildung AG organizza tirocini professionali, stage e perfezionamento orientati al mercato per circa 2.100 apprendisti in oltre 35 professioni diverse. Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come elettricista di rete: in EFZ 100% ## Ecco cosa puoi fare: - Come elettricista di rete, tu e i tuoi colleghi eseguite tutti i lavori di manutenzione, rinnovamento e risoluzione dei problemi sugli impianti di linee aeree. - Nel corso della formazione imparerai a utilizzare la piattaforma di lavoro aereo. - Sotto la supervisione di un esperto, effettuate operazioni di commutazione nella rete della linea di contatto. Dopo il tirocinio sarete autorizzati a utilizzare la rete Infrastruttura FFS. - Sei disposto a lavorare ad orari irregolari, soprattutto di notte e talvolta nei fine settimana. Puoi organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile durante la settimana. Il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana viene retribuito in aggiunta. Beneficerai anche di bonus di tempo. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. ## Ecco cosa porti con te: - Hai almeno 25 anni e vorresti imparare una nuova professione. - Possiedi competenze tecniche e possibilmente hai esperienza pratica nella catenaria, nella linea aerea o nella costruzione metallica. - Ti piace stare fuori con il vento e le intemperie. - Gli elettricisti di rete possono contare l'uno sull'altro perché lo spirito di squadra è importante tanto quanto le norme di sicurezza. - Hai una buona vista e udito e nessun disturbo nella visione dei colori ## Ecco cosa puoi aspettarti: come elettricista di rete, ti assicuri che la corrente elettrica circoli ogni giorno in modo che i nostri clienti arrivino a destinazione in tempo e in sicurezza. Lavori con la tua forza fisica o lasci che le macchine più moderne facciano il lavoro per te. La tua esperienza professionale vale qualcosa. Più esperienza professionale hai, più alto sarà il tuo stipendio durante e dopo il tuo apprendistato: nel primo anno di apprendistato il tuo stipendio sarà dell'80%, nel secondo anno di apprendistato sarà del 90% e nel terzo anno di apprendistato sarà del 95% dello stipendio calcolato dopo aver completato l'apprendistato. Saremo lieti di farti una proposta di stipendio provvisorio durante la consultazione iniziale. Completerai la tua formazione triennale in un team di gestione dei contatti presso FFS Infrastruttura e sarai assunto da login, il nostro partner per la formazione professionale. Sarai accompagnato da un formatore professionale qualificato. Allo stesso tempo, frequenti la scuola professionale. Interessato? In caso di domande sulla formazione potete contattare direttamente Rolf Bähni (41 79 621 26 04). Potete contattarci nei nostri orari d'ufficio dalle 8:00 alle 17:00. Il processo di candidatura viene eseguito dal nostro partner di formazione login Berufsbildung AG. Se hai domande sul processo di richiesta, il centro richieste di accesso sarà felice di aiutarti. login Centro Richiesta 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org Saremo lieti di accettare la tua richiesta tramite il nostro strumento di richiesta.
descriptionByLocale.en: Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a network electrician: in EFZ | login Vocational Training - - - - - - - - Your position in the world of mobility As an educational partner of the SBB, BLS, RhB, the Public Transport Association (VöV) and over 80 other mobility and mobility-related companies, login Berufsbildung AG organizes market-oriented vocational apprenticeships, internships and further training for around 2,100 trainees in over 35 different professions. Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a network electrician: in EFZ 100% ## This is what you can do: - As a network electrician, you and your colleagues carry out all maintenance, renewal work and troubleshooting on overhead line systems. - During the course of your training you will learn to operate the aerial work platform. - Under the supervision of an expert, you carry out switching operations in the contact line network. After your apprenticeship, you will be authorized to use the SBB Infrastructure network. - You are willing to work at irregular hours, especially at night and sometimes on weekends. You can organize your free time more flexibly during the week. Night and weekend work is paid additionally. You also benefit from time bonuses. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. ## This is what you bring with you: - You are at least 25 years old and would like to learn a new profession. - You are technically skilled and ideally have practical experience in catenary, overhead line or metal construction. - You like being outside in wind and weather. - Network electricians can rely on each other because team spirit is just as important as safety regulations. - You have good eyesight and hearing and no color vision impairment ## This is what you can look forward to: As a network electrician, you ensure that the electricity flows every day so that our customers reach their destination on time and safely. You work with your own physical strength or let the most modern machines do the work for you. Your professional experience is worth something. The more relevant professional experience you have, the higher your salary will be during and after your apprenticeship: in the first year of your apprenticeship your salary will be 80%, in the second year of your apprenticeship it will be 90% and in the third year of your apprenticeship it will be 95% of your calculated salary after completing your apprenticeship. We would be happy to make you a provisional salary suggestion during the initial consultation. You will complete your three-year training in a contact management team at SBB Infrastructure, and you will be employed by login, our partner for vocational training. You will be accompanied by a qualified vocational trainer. At the same time, you attend vocational school. Interested? If you have any questions about training, you can contact Rolf Bähni (41 79 621 26 04) directly. You can reach us during our office hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The application process is carried out by our training partner login Berufsbildung AG. If you have any questions about the application process, the login application center will be happy to help you. login Application Center 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org We will be happy to accept your application via our application tool.

descriptionByLocale.it: Inizia subito il tuo tirocinio retribuito per adulti come montatore di piste EFZ | login Formazione professionale - - - - - - - - La vostra posizione nel mondo della mobilità In qualità di partner educativo delle FFS, della BLS, della RhB, dell'Associazione dei trasporti pubblici (VöV) e di oltre 80 altre aziende legate alla mobilità e alla mobilità, login Berufsbildung AG organizza tirocini professionali, stage e perfezionamento orientati al mercato per circa 2.100 apprendisti in oltre 35 professioni diverse. Grazie ad una buona pianificazione e ad un'attenta preparazione del lavoro, ciò può essere ottenuto con precisione millimetrica. - Supportato dalle più moderne macchine per la costruzione dei binari, continuerai ad espandere la rete ferroviaria, a controllarla con dispositivi di misurazione precisi e a mantenerla con piccole macchine e dispositivi. - Sei disposto a lavorare ad orari irregolari, soprattutto di notte e talvolta nei fine settimana. Tuttavia, paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, sia in termini finanziari che in termini di tempo. Puoi però organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile durante la settimana e avere più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. ## Ecco cosa porti con te: - Hai almeno 25 anni e vorresti imparare una nuova professione. - Sei abile nell'artigianato. - Sei un vero giocatore di squadra e ti piace stare fuori con vento e intemperie. - I costruttori di piste possono contare l'uno sull'altro perché lo spirito di squadra è importante tanto quanto le norme di sicurezza. - Hai una buona vista e un buon udito e non hai problemi alla visione dei colori ## Puoi aspettarti questo: nel tuo lavoro di costruttore di binari contribuirai in modo significativo a garantire che l'offerta ferroviaria in Svizzera funzioni in modo puntuale e sicuro. Lavori con la tua forza fisica o lasci che le macchine più moderne facciano il lavoro per te. Per noi la tua esperienza professionale vale qualcosa. descriptionByLocale.en: Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a track fitter EFZ | login Vocational Training - - - - - - - - Your position in the world of mobility As an educational partner of the SBB, BLS, RhB, the Public Transport Association (VöV) and over 80 other mobility and mobility-related companies, login Berufsbildung AG organizes market-oriented vocational apprenticeships, internships and further training for around 2,100 trainees in over 35 different professions. Start your paid adult apprenticeship now as a track fitter EFZ 100% ## This is what you can do: - As a track fitter, you and your colleagues carry out all maintenance work and troubleshooting on the track and switch systems. - You carry out all track conversions and new track construction as a team. Thanks to good planning and careful work preparation, this can be achieved with millimeter precision. - Supported by the most modern track construction machines, you will continue to expand the rail network, control it with precise measuring devices and maintain it with small machines and devices. - You are willing to work at irregular hours, especially at night and sometimes on weekends. However, we pay additional compensation for night and weekend work, both financially and in terms of time. However, you can organize your free time more flexibly during the week and have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. ## This is what you bring with you: - You are at least 25 years old and would like to learn a new profession. - You are skilled at craftsmanship. - You are a real team player and enjoy being outside in wind and weather. - Track builders can rely on each other because team spirit is just as important as safety regulations. - You have good eyesight and hearing and no color vision impairment ## You can look forward to this: In your job as a track builder, you will make a significant contribution to ensuring that train services in Switzerland run punctually and safely. You work with your own physical strength or let the most modern machines do the work for you. Your professional experience is worth something to us. The more relevant professional experience you have, the higher your salary will be during and after your apprenticeship: in the first year of your apprenticeship your salary will be 80%, in the second year of your apprenticeship it will be 90% and in the third year of your apprenticeship it will be 95% of your calculated salary after completing your apprenticeship. We would be happy to make you a provisional salary suggestion during the initial consultation. In the first year of the three-year training course, you complete the basic training at login. You will then move to SBB for the second and third year of your apprenticeship. You will be accompanied by a qualified vocational trainer. At the same time, you will attend vocational school. Interested? If you have any questions about training, you can contact Andreas Stähli directly (41 79 751 93 49). You can reach us during our office hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The application process is carried out by our training partner login Berufsbildung AG. If you have any questions about the application process, the login application center will be happy to help you. login Application Center 0848 822 422 bewerbung@login.org We will be happy to accept your application via our application tool.

Agente di polizia presso la base della polizia dei trasporti di Winterthur, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Per la nostra nuova sede a Winterthur cerchiamo agenti di polizia impegnati e motivati ​​che vogliano dedicarsi a un posto entusiasmante e vario. Per noi l’attenzione non è sul lavoro d’ufficio, ma sulla polizia di prossimità, al passo con ciò che accade nel trasporto pubblico, con una chiara attenzione ai compiti della polizia di sicurezza. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer at the Winterthur transport police base, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. For our new office in Winterthur, we are looking for committed and motivated police officers who would like to dedicate themselves to an exciting and varied position. For us, the focus is not on office work, but on community policing at the pulse of what is happening in public transport with a clear focus on security police tasks. We also work regularly with other police forces and partner organizations, which will expand your network. Become part of an appreciative, dynamic and motivated team that ensures security and order beyond the canton's borders. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you will ensure safety, peace and order with over 190 colleagues in the train stations and on public transport from various transport companies. - You provide a uniformed and civilian presence in means of transport, in train stations and on the premises of the transport companies. - You contribute to the protection and safety of our travelers and public transport staff. - With police interventions, also together with partner organizations, you take responsibility for security and order. - The exciting challenges also include deployments in event trains and at major events in the Swiss operational area. This is what you bring with you. - You are a service-oriented, open and winning personality, as you are in daily contact with our customers. - For us, teamwork is the key to success. You are a team player and look forward to working together as a team. - You have the federal police officer I certificate and have good police tactical/technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written expression in the German language. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You also have good IT/administrative skills that you can use in a goal-oriented manner. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. descriptionByLocale.fr: Officier de police : dans la police des transports 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Officier de police à la base de la police des transports de Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Pour notre nouveau bureau de Winterthour, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Nous travaillons également régulièrement avec d'autres corps de police et organismes partenaires, ce qui élargira votre réseau. Faites partie d'une équipe appréciée, dynamique et motivée qui veille à la sécurité et à l'ordre au-delà des frontières du canton. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant qu'officier de police des transports des CFF, vous assurez la sécurité, la tranquillité et l'ordre avec plus de 190 collègues dans les gares et dans les transports publics de différentes entreprises de transport. - Vous assurez une présence en uniforme et civile dans les moyens de transport, dans les gares et dans les locaux des entreprises de transport. - Vous contribuez à la protection et à la sécurité de nos voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Avec les interventions de la police, également en collaboration avec des organisations partenaires, vous assumez la responsabilité de la sécurité et de l'ordre. - Les défis passionnants incluent également les déploiements dans des trains événementiels et lors de grands événements dans le domaine opérationnel suisse. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes une personnalité orientée service, ouverte et gagnante, car vous êtes en contact quotidien avec nos clients. - Pour nous, le travail d'équipe est la clé du succès. Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et avez hâte de travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes titulaire du brevet de policier fédéral I et possédez de bonnes connaissances tactiques/techniques policières. - Vous vous caractérisez par une très bonne expression orale et écrite en langue allemande. La connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est un avantage. - Vous possédez également de bonnes compétences informatiques/administratives que vous pouvez utiliser de manière ciblée. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence H, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. - Du verfügst über eine Atemschutztauglichkeit und hast Erfahrung als Feuerwehrperson.
- In der deutschen Sprache bist du verhandlungssicher (mündlich und schriftlich) und du bist bereit, ein Französisch-Diplom auf Niveau A1 zu absolvieren.

Specialista in ingresso laterale: nel soccorso ferroviario Ostermundigen, 1 agosto 2026, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Con Intervento FFS siete pronti 24 ore su 24 in caso di emergenza. Oltre 80 moderni veicoli di emergenza sono in uso su rotaie e strade. Cosa rende unico questo lavoro? Sei uno specialista ferroviario, un macchinista e un pompiere tutto in uno. Garantirai la sicurezza dei nostri clienti durante un evento e contribuirai a garantire che il traffico ferroviario ritorni alla normalità il più rapidamente possibile. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti. Puoi spostarlo. - In caso di allarme o durante le esercitazioni, come macchinista sarai schierato con la tua squadra sul treno antincendio e di soccorso e garantirai la sicurezza dei nostri clienti. - In caso di incidenti che riguardano il traffico ferroviario, sei corresponsabile della protezione delle persone, degli animali, dell'ambiente e dell'infrastruttura ferroviaria. - Sul posto garantisci la sicurezza di tutti i viaggiatori, combatti gli incendi sui binari e in prossimità di essi, fornisci protezione da oli e sostanze chimiche e assistenza tecnica. L’uso dei droni aiuta a valutare rapidamente la situazione. - Ti alleni regolarmente sui vari processi e tecniche di lavoro per garantire una gestione degli eventi fluida in ogni momento. Lavorerai su turni di 24 ore dal lunedì al venerdì e sarai reperibile nel fine settimana. Per noi gli orari di lavoro irregolari sono la regola. Ma potrete usufruire delle piste da sci gratuite durante la settimana e organizzare il vostro tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Scopri di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Grazie al tuo elevato senso di responsabilità e sicurezza, comprendi le dipendenze e gli effetti sulla tua squadra e sul tuo lavoro. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry specialist: in railway rescue 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry specialist: in railway rescue Ostermundigen, August 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. With SBB Intervention, you are ready around the clock in case of an emergency. Over 80 modern emergency vehicles are in use on rails and roads. What makes this job unique? You are a railway specialist, train driver and firefighter all in one. You will ensure the safety of our customers during an event and help ensure that rail traffic returns to normal as quickly as possible. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can move that. - In the event of an alarm or during exercises, as a train driver you will be deployed with your team in the fire and rescue train and ensure the safety of our customers. - In the event of incidents that affect rail traffic, you are jointly responsible for the protection of people, animals, the environment and rail infrastructure. - On site you ensure the safety of all travelers, fight fires on and next to the tracks, provide oil and chemical protection and technical assistance. The use of drones helps to quickly assess the situation. - You regularly train the various work processes and techniques to ensure smooth event management at all times. You will work 24-hour shifts from Monday to Friday and will be on call at the weekend. Irregular working hours are the rule for us. But you can enjoy free ski slopes during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. Find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your high sense of responsibility and security, you understand the dependencies and effects on your team and your work. What counts for us is togetherness and community in a team that you can rely on at any time. This means that you enjoy working independently and are physically and mentally resilient. - You have completed a vocational apprenticeship with a federal certificate of proficiency (EFZ). You already have a driving license for locomotives in category B100 or are willing to complete the relevant internal paid training. - You have a category B and ideally also category C1 118 driving license. - You are suitable for respiratory protection and have experience as a firefighter. - You are fluent in the German language (orally and in writing) and you are ready to complete a French diploma at level A1. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102797 Philippe Weyeneth, Ostermundigen site manager Telephone +41 79 593 47 42 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB Cargo bist du am Puls der Schweizer Wirtschaft. SBB Cargo transportiert täglich 185.000 Tonnen und entlastet damit die Straße um 15.000 LKW-Fahrten pro Tag und die Umwelt jährlich um 460.000 Tonnen CO2. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB Cargo bewegst. Zudem erhältst du eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung im Rangierbahnhof. Darüber hinaus stehen dir verschiedene Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten wie die Ausbildung zum/zur Rangierlokführer:inn offen.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmäßigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30%. Das bedeutet, dass du mehr Freizeit hast als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

- Du übernimmst die Wagen, führst Sicherheitskontrollen durch und bereitest den Zug durch komplexe Rangierbewegungen für die nächste Fahrt vor.
- Du erfasst die notwendigen Daten für die Zugführung mit persönlichen, modernen IT-Geräten (z.B. Tablet).
- Durch das rechtzeitige Zu- und Abstellen der Wagen beim Kunden hast du täglich direkten Kundenkontakt. Du nimmst ihre Rückmeldungen entgegen und leitest sie bei Bedarf an die zuständige Stelle weiter.
Hier erfährst du mehr zum Berufsbild.

- Du bist aufmerksam, konzentriert und körperlich belastbar, um diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb erfolgreich zu bewältigen. Ausserdem arbeitest du gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Idealerweise hast du eine Grundausbildung abgeschlossen oder bringst bereits Berufserfahrung im handwerklichen, logistischen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
- Da sämtliche Anweisungen und Dokumentationen elektronisch sind, wirst du dich schnell mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln zurechtfinden.
- In Deutsch (Niveau C1) bis du fliessend in Wort und Schrift.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot-Grün-Schwäche) und weist keine Einträge im Straf- und Betreibungsregister auf.

Specialista della manovra: nella stazione della squadra Ai40 Berna, su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce il carico sulle strade di 15.000 viaggi di camion al giorno e riduce l'impatto sull'ambiente di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 ogni anno. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo in cui voi e i vostri collaboratori potrete far progredire FFS Cargo. Riceverai anche una formazione varia e retribuita nello scalo di smistamento. Avete a disposizione anche diverse opportunità di perfezionamento, come ad esempio la formazione per diventare macchinista di manovra. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni riceverai anche un'indennità compresa tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Possibili date di inizio nel 2026: - 1 agosto 2026 - 1 ottobre 2026 Puoi fare la differenza. - In qualità di specialista delle manovre, contribuirai a garantire che i nostri clienti siano serviti in modo affidabile e puntuale preparando i treni merci per il loro viaggio. - Prendi in consegna i vagoni, esegui i controlli di sicurezza e prepari il treno per il viaggio successivo attraverso complessi movimenti di manovra. - Registrate i dati necessari per il percorso del treno utilizzando moderni dispositivi informatici personali (ad es. tablet). - Consegnando e riconsegnando le auto presso la sede del cliente in modo tempestivo, hai un contatto diretto con il cliente su base giornaliera. Ricevi il loro feedback e, se necessario, lo inoltri all'ufficio responsabile. Puoi scoprire di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei attento, concentrato e fisicamente resistente per completare con successo questo lavoro impegnativo in turni di 24 ore. Ti piace anche lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Idealmente, hai completato la formazione di base o hai già esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in un settore comparabile. - Poiché tutte le istruzioni e la documentazione sono elettroniche, potrai orientarti rapidamente utilizzando gli strumenti digitali. - In tedesco (livello C1) finché non parli e scrivi fluentemente. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito E, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. descriptionByLocale.en: Shunting specialist: in team station Ai40 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting specialist: in team station Ai40 Bern, by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You will also receive varied and paid training in the marshalling yard. There are also various further training opportunities available to you, such as training to become a shunting engine driver. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will also receive a time allowance of between 10 and 30%. This means that you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates in 2026: - August 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - As a shunting specialist, you will help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time by preparing freight trains for their journey. - You take over the cars, carry out safety checks and prepare the train for the next journey through complex shunting movements. - You record the necessary data for train routing using personal, modern IT devices (e.g. tablet). - By delivering and dropping off the cars at the customer's site in a timely manner, you have direct customer contact on a daily basis. You receive their feedback and, if necessary, forward it to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Ideally, you have completed basic training or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - In German (level C1) until you are fluent in speech and writing. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102668 Beat Aeschlimann, team leader Telephone +41 79 610 93 18 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Spécialiste des manœuvres : au poste d'équipe Ai40 Berne, sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Chez CFF Cargo, vous prenez le pouls de l'économie suisse. CFF Cargo transporte 185 000 tonnes par jour, réduisant ainsi la pollution routière de 15 000 déplacements de camion par jour et l'impact sur l'environnement de 460 000 tonnes de CO2 par an. Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend dans lequel vous et vos collaborateurs ferez avancer CFF Cargo. Vous bénéficierez également d'une formation variée et rémunérée en gare de triage. Diverses possibilités de formation continue s'offrent également à vous, comme par exemple la formation de conducteur de locomotive de manœuvre. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficierez également d'une indemnité de temps comprise entre 10 et 30 %. Am strategisch wichtigen Stützpunkt in Olten suchen wir im Rahmen eines Aufbaus mehrere Polizist:innen. - Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf uniformierten Patrouillendiensten in Transportmitteln, Bahnhöfen sowie auf den Arealen der Transportunternehmen.

Puoi scegliere il tuo carico di lavoro in modo flessibile tra il 40 e il 100%, non è necessario avere un luogo di residenza.
